title: Booking Ahead on Ridgeline Tool Rental: ProBuild Rate Points
content:
Reserving Ridgeline Tool Rental equipment ahead of pickup raises the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement.

Booking ahead adds points: a reservation made at least 7 calendar days before the scheduled pickup date adds half a point (0.5); a reservation made 3 to 6 calendar days before the scheduled pickup date adds a quarter point (0.25); a reservation made fewer than 3 calendar days before the scheduled pickup date adds none.

The points are added to the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement point for point, whatever the ProBuild tier's own rental discount percentage, a tier percentage of zero included.

The lead is counted in calendar days from the reservation date on the agreement to the date part of the booked pickup time.

## Lead-time table

| Calendar days from reservation date to pickup date | Points added |
|---|---|
| 7 or more | 0.5 |
| 3, 4, 5 or 6 | 0.25 |
| 0, 1 or 2 | 0 |

## Hypothetical bookings (pickup booked for 20 May at 07:00)

| Reservation date | Lead in calendar days | Points |
|---|---|---|
| 13 May | 7 | 0.5 |
| 14 May | 6 | 0.25 |
| 17 May | 3 | 0.25 |
| 18 May | 2 | 0 |
| 20 May (written at the counter) | 0 | 0 |
